description: Explainable risk model R = sum(weight_c * component_c), components on 0-100. All values are configurable initial heuristics chosen by the project author, not cybersecurity standards.
changelog: 2026-11-08: unverified model-only technique suggestions no longer count (method factor 0.5 -> 0); analyst-confirmed suggestions count like explicit matches (confirmed_model 1.0); rejected mappings count for nothing. Reason: on 14 real CISA advisories only 10% of model-only suggestions matched a technique CISA cites (docs/evaluation/real_world_analysis.md). This is a policy change, not a value tuned on that test set: 0 removes unvalidated output from the score, and the test set is not re-scored to claim an improvement. The model-only confidence warning is removed because leads no longer affect the score.

2026-11-07b: defense-evasion replaced by defense-impairment (ATT&CK v20.1 split it into stealth and defense-impairment); model-suggestion factor 0.8 -> 0.5 and breadth bonus restricted to explicit/corroborated techniques, because model suggestions showed false positives on non-technique sentences (headings, acknowledgements) and their false-positive rate on real reports is unmeasured.
